subject: Future Tech
title: Resources Beyond Earth
description: A quick, practical guide to Resources Beyond Earth.

hook.text: A single metallic asteroid could contain more platinum than has ever been mined in all of human history.

buildup.text: The asteroid belt holds trillions of tons of iron, nickel, cobalt, and rare earth elements essential for technology.

discovery.text: Lunar soil contains helium-3, a potential fuel for future fusion reactors that barely exists on Earth.

twist.text: Mining in space is staggeringly expensive today. Launching equipment costs thousands of dollars per kilogram.

climax.text: If launch costs keep dropping, space mining could flip from fantasy to industry within a few decades.

punchline.text: Earth's rarest metals are common in the sky.

quiz.question: What potential fusion fuel is found in lunar soil?
